mapper.sql: M.MENU_ID, M.PARENT_MENU_ID, M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.MENU_LEVEL, M.MENU_TYPE, M.SCREEN_ID, M.FORM_PATH, M.ICON_NAME, M.SORT_ORDER, M.SENSITIVE_YN, M.USE_YN, M.CREATED_AT, M.CREATED_BY, M.UPDATED_AT, M.UPDATED_BY, COALESCE(M.UPDATED_AT, M.CREATED_AT) AS REVISION_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM S2C_MENU M ORDER BY M.MENU_LEVEL, M.SORT_ORDER, M.MENU_ID
SELECT FROM S2C_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = #{menuId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM S2C_MENU M WHERE UPPER(M.MENU_CODE) = UPPER(#{menuCode})
SELECT FROM S2C_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID IN ( SELECT MENU_ID FROM S2C_MENU START WITH MENU_ID = #{menuId} CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR MENU_ID = PARENT_MENU_ID ) FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM S2C_MENU WHERE UPPER(MENU_CODE) = UPPER(#{menuCode})
AND MENU_ID <> #{excludedMenuId}

WITH SUBTREE AS ( SELECT MENU_ID FROM S2C_MENU START WITH MENU_ID = #{rootMenuId} CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR MENU_ID = PARENT_MENU_ID ) SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM ( SELECT UR.USER_ID FROM S2C_USER_ROLE UR JOIN S2C_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN S2C_ROLE_MENU_AUTH A ON A.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN SUBTREE S ON S.MENU_ID = A.MENU_ID WHERE UR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND UR.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND (UR.VALID_TO IS NULL OR UR.VALID_TO >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))
UNION
SELECT UMA.USER_ID FROM S2C_USER_MENU_AUTH UMA JOIN SUBTREE S ON S.MENU_ID = UMA.MENU_ID WHERE UMA.USE_YN = 'Y' AND UMA.VALID_FROM <= SYSDATE AND (UMA.VALID_TO IS NULL OR UMA.VALID_TO >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO S2C_MENU ( PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_CODE, MENU_NAME, MENU_LEVEL, MENU_TYPE, SCREEN_ID, FORM_PATH, ICON_NAME, SORT_ORDER, SENSITIVE_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{parentMenuId}, #{menuCode}, #{menuName}, #{menuLevel}, #{menuType}, #{screenId}, #{formPath}, #{iconName}, #{sortOrder}, #{sensitiveYn}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP, #{actor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE S2C_MENU SET PARENT_MENU_ID = #{parentMenuId}, MENU_NAME = #{menuName}, MENU_LEVEL = #{menuLevel}, MENU_TYPE = #{menuType}, SCREEN_ID = #{screenId}, FORM_PATH = #{formPath}, ICON_NAME = #{iconName}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, SENSITIVE_YN = #{sensitiveYn}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{actor} WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}

UPDATE S2C_MENU SET USE_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{actor} WHERE MENU_ID IN ( SELECT MENU_ID FROM S2C_MENU START WITH MENU_ID = #{menuId} CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR MENU_ID = PARENT_MENU_ID ) AND USE_YN = 'Y'
